title: Two schedulers, one valid executor
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Start two schedulers; use lease/fencing evidence to identify the valid executor.
sourceAcceptance: Use suitable ownership leases and fencing to prevent duplicate scheduled work.
parentAcceptance: Only the valid owner performs each scheduled effect; duplicate scheduling is detected.
preconditions: Standalone modern browser, no server, scheduler service, resource, credentials or subscription.
Exactly two synthetic schedulers v1 and v2 propose the same JOB-078@6 occurrence.
v1 checked epoch 7 at tick 4, expires at 5; v2 acquires epoch 8 at 6, expires at 10.
The expected occurrence requires one effect by the current owner; all clocks and receipts are teaching fixtures.
actions: Choose enforced fencing or deliberately unsafe cached-lease-only execution and the v2 receipt condition.
Start both schedulers and detect their duplicate scheduling proposal.
Expire the old lease and grant v2 epoch 8; inspect current and expired lease evidence.
Attempt both callbacks and inspect known, rejected and unresolved effects.
Identify the valid executor and PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN without relabeling observed work.
Retain up to six complete ledgers or explicitly reset all in-memory state and history.
trace: One occurrence, two schedulers, one explicit handoff, two execution attempts, full retained lease/proposal/effect histories.
assertions: Two proposals for one occurrence detect one duplicate scheduling proposal.
Only v2 is authorized after the epoch-7 lease expires and v2 acquires epoch 8.
Enforced current-owner fencing rejects stale v1 and permits one observed v2 effect: PASS.
Cached lease checks without effect-boundary fencing expose an invalid v1 effect and duplicate work: FAIL.
A missing v2 receipt stays unresolved: UNKNOWN unless a known ownership violation already establishes FAIL.
Interpretation cannot rewrite verdicts or retained evidence.
Exact enum inputs, branded immutable states, phase ordering and six-attempt limits are enforced.
Actual DOM, keyboard, errors, failure, uncertainty, all-phase reset and enforced CSP are checked.
limits: No actual scheduler, distributed lease authority, monotonic token issuance, fencing or effect execution is certified.
No real atomic effect boundary, durability, clock-skew safety, crash recovery or production reliability proof.
B-S078 and D-S078 remain incomplete; this is not native Azure or source-parent completion.
Not S075 consumer expansion, S076 retirement, S077 redelivery or S084 command idempotency.
No production Node.js 24 or five-nines validation; Node 22 is test tooling only.
Published isolated browser helper only; known lifecycle limitation remains and abandoned prototype is unqualified.
File-origin worker rejection is not independent worker-src CSP qualification.
Synthetic data only; no cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, downloads, installs or spending.
One frozen S unit. Tests, browser proof, plumbing and refinement earn no additional credit.
